name: Built-in Postgres (Drizzle)
description: Replit-managed Postgres with Drizzle ORM. Schema-first, typed queries, easy migrations.

requiredSecrets.name: DATABASE_URL
requiredSecrets.reason: Postgres connection string (Replit provisions this automatically when you add a Postgres database).

postInstallNotes:
1. Run `npx drizzle-kit push` to sync the schema to your Postgres database.
2. Import `db` from `./src/db/client` and query with `db.select().from(usersTable)`.
3. Add columns to `schema.ts` then re-run `drizzle-kit push`.
